Today, there is an update on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
A low-pressure system over the Bay of Bengal was expected to intensify into a depression on October 31st, 2026. This development was reported on October 30th, indicating a potential precursor to a cyclonic event affecting the Chennai–Puducherry coast. The intensification of such a system is a significant step in the formation of a cyclone, making it a relevant development for those monitoring weather patterns in the region.
